pages.title: Helping at a book sale · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in Madison. The city library has a big book sale for charity. It is a fundraiser for the children’s reading room. Carlos arrives early with a bottle of water. A woman named Wendy holds a clipboard and a pen. She looks happy to see another volunteer.
“Hi! Thank you for coming to the book sale. Are you a new volunteer?” says Wendy. “Yes, I am. What can I do first?” says Carlos. “Can you put the paperbacks on that table?” says Wendy.
